verdict.rationale: Sentry's homepage claims Seer, a first-party debugging agent, finds root causes of production issues and generates merge-ready patches. That is AI-generated insight and suggestions drawn from the user's error data, inside the product. The evidence is only two marketing lines with no product docs on how the insights are produced or surfaced. The Agents dashboards are observability of the user's own AI apps, not AI-generated insights, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Seer's insight and suggestion workflow, AI insights beyond issue debugging (e.g. performance or trend analysis), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent]
